title: Nexus Between Financial Technology and Financial Inclusion in Sub-Saharan Africa: A Dynamic Panel Technique

paper_level.sample_description: 30 SSA countries (29 groups in regressions), 2004-2021, SSA only, no income-group split
paper_level.technology_measure_main: FT: PCA index of mobile subscriptions per 100, internet subscriptions per 100, population density, population size
paper_level.outcome_main: Financial inclusion index (ATM and bank-branch based PCA); sub-indices accessibility, usage, availability. Not output or productivity

notes: Outcome is financial inclusion (family 5), not output or productivity; real GDP appears only as a control, so no estimates are extracted. No text aimed at the extractor was found.
